name: Butternut squash & sage risotto
steps: Soften the onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add the diced butternut squash and cook for a few minutes.
Stir in the arborio rice to coat.
Add the warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed.
Cook until the rice and squash are tender and creamy.
Stir through the parmesan and serve.
